description: Shows real Google Chrome (headless, managed, device-SSO capable) inside an editor tab and exposes it to agents.
welcome.launcher:
Real Google Chrome in an editor tab, signed in with this Mac's Caseware device identity. Pages can be shared with agents.
[New Chrome Tab](command:marvincode.chrome.newTab)
[Open URL…](command:marvincode.chrome.openUrl)
config.colorScheme: Whether Chrome Tabs ask sites for their dark theme (the `prefers-color-scheme` media feature). The moon button in the Chrome Tab toolbar switches between `light` and `dark`.
config.colorScheme.dark: Sites that have a dark theme use it.
config.colorScheme.theme: Dark when the color theme is dark or high contrast, light otherwise.
config.forceDark: In dark mode, also darken sites that have no dark theme (Chrome's Auto Dark Mode). Colors and images on those sites can look off.
command.openActiveBrowserPage: Move Integrated Browser Page to Chrome Tab
config.title: Chrome Tab
config.hosts: Hosts whose links open in a Chrome Tab instead of the external browser, e.g. `*.sharepoint.com`, `*.office.com`, `myapps.microsoft.com`. Use this for sites behind Microsoft device-based Conditional Access, which the Integrated Browser cannot pass.
config.executablePath: Path to the Chrome binary. Leave empty to use the installed Google Chrome.
config.deviceScaleFactor: Pixel density Chrome renders at. `0` uses the display density of the first Chrome Tab (2 on Retina). Takes effect after **Chrome Tab: Restart Chrome**.
config.frameQuality: JPEG quality of the streamed frames (30–100). Lower values use less CPU on large or fast-changing pages.
config.askBeforeSharing: Ask before **Share with Agent** in the Chrome Tab toolbar shares a page. Turned off by **Always Share**. Requests that come from an agent always ask.
